metadata.pca_solver: scikit-learn PCA with all available components
metadata.loading_score: sum of squared unit-eigenvector coefficients over PC1..PCdi
metadata.scree_elbow_method: Interior eigenvalue farthest from the straight line joining the first and last scree points; heuristic only.
metadata.kmeans_elbow_method: Interior mean-squared-distance point farthest from the straight line joining k=1 and the maximum tested k; heuristic only.
metadata.kmeans_distance_definition: mean squared Euclidean distance to the assigned centroid = inertia / observation count
